settings.name_in_paper: Conservative contextual combinatorial cascading bandit (unknown conservative reward)
unmapped: base-arm weights are linear in contexts: E[w_{t,e}] = theta*^T x_{t,e}
position discounts gamma_k known to the learner
baseline list reward unknown; its context is observed
regret measured against alpha times the optimal reward (approximation oracle)
settings.definition_quote: $C^4$-UCB with Unknown Conservative Reward ... \KwIn{$\gamma_k \in [0,1]_{k \leq K};\delta =\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}; \lambda \geq C_{\gamma} =\sum_{k=1}^K \gamma_k^2,\epsilon,N_0=D_0=\emptyset$}

symbols.B_lip: Lipschitz constant B of the reward function f in the base-arm weights
symbols.u_0: expected reward of the conservative (baseline) list
symbols.Delta_l: lower gap between alpha*f(A*) and the baseline reward
symbols.d_T: number of rounds the conservative action is played up to T

conditions: on the event that theta* lies in the confidence set for all t
p* lower bound on probability of observing all positions

source.label: thm2
source.quote: On event $\xi=\{\theta^* \in c_t,\forall t \in N\}$,for any $T\geq 1$,we have d_T \leq -\frac{ 27 BR\sqrt{2kd}d^2(1+C_{\gamma}/(\lambda d))^{1/2} }{4p^*(\epsilon u_0+\Delta_l)^3\epsilon u_0}  +(1/\epsilon-1)u_0+1.

results.notes: Bound on number of conservative plays d_T, not regret. The sign of the leading term looks erroneous in the paper (negative), recorded verbatim. Paper's k/K is the list length, mapped to m; R is noise sub-Gaussian level mapped to sigma. Proof also derives a regret bound with an extra (Omega/(eps u0)+1)Delta_h term.

symbols.Omega: problem-dependent constant defined in the theorem (max of two expressions in B, R, p*, d, K, epsilon, u_0, Delta_l, lambda)
symbols.u_0: expected reward of the baseline list
symbols.Delta_h: upper gap (max loss of playing the baseline)

conditions: p* lower bound on probability of observing all positions

source.quote: If $\lambda \geq L$, then the following regret bound of \textbf{Algorithm 2} is satisfied with probability at least $1-\delta$ R^{\alpha}(T) \leq \frac{2\sqrt{2}B}{p^*}(R\sqrt{\ln[(1+C_\gamma T/(\lambda d))^dT]}+\sqrt{\lambda})\sqrt{TKd\ln(1+C_\gamma T/(\lambda d))}+\alpha \sqrt{T}+(\frac{\Omega}{\epsilon u_0}+1)\Delta_h =O(d\sqrt{TK}\ln(C_\gamma T)+(\frac{\Omega}{\epsilon u_0}+1)\Delta_h)

results.notes: Paper's K is the max list length (mapped to m). Exact form: (2*sqrt(2)*B/p*)*(R*sqrt(log((1+C_gamma T/(lam d))^d T))+sqrt(lam))*sqrt(T K d log(1+C_gamma T/(lam d))) + alpha*sqrt(T) + (Omega/(eps u0)+1)*Delta_h. Omega depends on beta_{t-1}(delta), notation sloppy. Comparator is alpha times the per-round optimal list given contexts.
